test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Many experts recommend that you exercise for 30 minutes every day, 5-6 days a week.

B. Regular exercise is one of the most effective and simple ways to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

C. Something as basic as 30 minutes of brisk walking or stretching can add several healthy years to your life.

D. Regular exercise can help you manage your weight, build your bones and muscles, and lower your risk of diabetes, heart disease and stroke.
solution:
The correct answer is **"BDAC​".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **B**. Regular exercise is one of the most effective and simple ways to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

 
 
• This sentence introduces the general concept of regular exercise as important for maintaining health.
 
 
 
• **D**. Regular exercise can help you manage your weight, build your bones and muscles, and lower your risk of diabetes, heart disease and stroke.
 
 
• This sentence elaborates on the benefits of regular exercise mentioned in the first sentence.
 
 
 
• **A**. Many experts recommend that you exercise for 30 minutes every day, 5-6 days a week.
 
 
• This sentence provides specific advice from experts on how much exercise is recommended.
 
 
 
• **C. **Something as basic as 30 minutes of brisk walking or stretching can add several healthy years to your life.
 
 
• This sentence emphasizes that even simple forms of exercise, like walking or stretching, can have significant health benefits, tying back to the recommendation in the previous sentence.
 
 

So, the proper order (BDAC) logically transitions from the general idea of the importance of exercise, to specific benefits, expert recommendations, and finally, simple examples of effective exercise.
